metaTitle: How to Choose Tent Stakes by Ground
description: Pick tent stakes by soil type: steel for rock, long wide stakes for sand, deadman anchors for snow. Includes lengths, materials and wind tips.
directAnswer: Match stakes to the ground: 8 to 10 inch steel or aluminum for firm soil, short thick steel for rock, 12 inch or wider stakes or buried anchors for sand, and deadman anchors for snow. Drive them at about 45 degrees away from the tent.
